head_commit.message:
fix(psc0): correct native grammar build blockers and collect regression outcomes [sh1-qualify]

Rename the reserved postfix local without losing the compiled grammar identity.
Use a direct List constructor match for empty-call refusal in Term, preserving
the nonempty application branch and avoiding a new dependency. Collect all three
existing native suite outcomes before failing the regression step.

Retain the exact first cloud attempt and its skipped qualification status.
The selected seed, provider, fuel checks and grammar acceptance policy are unchanged.

scope: Exact timestamped compact log records plus parsed analysis objects. The recovery runner separately reports receiptSha256 computed from the original receipt file before adding that digest to its log record. This bundle does not claim to contain the artifact's original receipt-file bytes; the collector must preserve and independently hash those bytes.
